column3: he wanted me to pass along a message.
the kid's been coding a ton lately.
working himself to the bone... huh?
says he wants to marry you.
he thinks about the future with you all the time.
he keeps saying that joining that random
discord call was the best choice he ever made.
flipped his life goals around... and...
pretty heavy stuff for a chat room... huh?
for the times he made you feel horrible.
and hey... if anything's ever bothering you...
he wants you to just shoot him a message...
and hey... he wants you to know
you can count on him for anything.
you can just talk to him...
...that boy told me you're his dream man.
one little thing i gotta test out first.
let's see if you can actually
hold your own in a fight.
you're gonna have a bad time.
